detail.providersDescription: Shows provider configurations and availability for this model identifier.
editor.bindingCardDescription: Configure deployment, availability, and provider-specific request settings.
editor.bindingDescription: Add at least one provider. Each configuration is saved as an independent model record.
editor.commonDescription: This information will be copied to every related provider model record.
editor.deleteFailed: Failed to remove the provider configuration. Save again to retry.
editor.description: Shared information is written to each provider configuration. Failed configurations can be retried separately.
editor.editDescription: Shared information will be updated across all related provider configurations.
editor.field.name: Model display name
editor.fieldDesc.bindingStatus: When disabled, this model is not used through the selected provider.
editor.fieldDesc.category: Defines the model capability category and determines the available runtime settings and provider types.
editor.fieldDesc.chatApi: Applies only to OpenAI-compatible providers. Defaults to Chat Completions; some models can switch to Responses.
editor.fieldDesc.currency: Used for billing and pricing settings under this provider configuration.
editor.fieldDesc.extraBody: Add request body fields as a JSON object when this provider requires extra parameters.
editor.fieldDesc.extraHeader: Add request headers as a JSON object when this provider requires extra headers.
editor.fieldDesc.icon: Upload the model display icon. A default model icon is used when empty.
editor.fieldDesc.loadWeight: When multiple available configurations share a model identifier, requests are distributed by weight with smooth weighted round-robin to avoid overloading one endpoint.
editor.fieldDesc.maxOutputTokens: Sets the maximum Tokens supported in a single model response.
editor.fieldDesc.maxTokens: Sets the maximum context Tokens supported by the model.
editor.fieldDesc.modelId: Groups configurations of the same model across providers. Select an existing identifier or create a new one.
editor.fieldDesc.modelType: Further defines how the model is used and determines its available runtime settings.
editor.fieldDesc.modelVersion: The deployment or model name sent to the provider.
editor.fieldDesc.pricingTemplate: The template determines which sale and cost items need to be configured.
editor.fieldDesc.provider: Select a configured provider. An independent model configuration is saved for it.
editor.fieldDesc.supportThink: Reasoning support depends on the model itself. Verify that it works before enabling it.
editor.fieldDesc.supportTool: Tool support depends on the model itself. Verify that it works before enabling it.
editor.fieldDesc.supportVision: Vision support depends on the model itself. Verify that it works before enabling it.
editor.fieldDesc.temperature: Controls the randomness of model responses. Higher values generally produce more creative results.
editor.fieldDesc.temperatureMode: Recommended temperature is controlled by the caller; fixed temperature constrains requests to the value set here.
editor.fieldDesc.vectorSize: Sets the vector length, which determines the complexity and capacity of the model's feature representation.
editor.iconUploadHint: PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG, or WebP, up to 2MB.
